text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. My head hurts. It really hurts.
This is quite a predicament. What a trouble, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after we finished our training meeting,
she suddenly began complaining of feeling unwell in an overly dramatic fashion.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I am perfectly fine.
Because Machan has a powerful ally... Whatzitsname Pharmaceuticals' headache medicine!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...What do you think of Chan-me's acting?
With this, no matter when a commercial offer comes in—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it... this pain wasn't an act after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I actually took some over-the-counter medicine, but...
the headache showed no signs of easing.
